articleTitle: 90 lakh cheque, fake threat, cheap flat bait: How Yuvraj Manchanda was trapped, killed
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Yuvraj Singh Manchanda murder Gurugram drain, Anya Vats Sanyam Sachdeva Yuvraj Manchanda case, Yuvraj Manchanda Adani Realty manager murder, Badshahpur drain body recovery Gurugram, Anya Vats cheating racket ED notices, Lajpat Nagar missing person Gurugram murder.
description: The Delhi Police claimed the accused, Anya Vats, was trying to raise the money to settle a cheating case when she allegedly devised a plan to kill her former colleague, Yuvraj Manchanda, with her live-in partner.
body_raw: On September 2, Yuvraj Manchanda, a manager at Adani Realty, was sitting at Roots Cafe in Gurugrams Sector 29 with Anya Vats, a former colleague who now worked as a freelance real estate agent. Yuvraj, 31, was getting married in October and was looking to buy a home. Anya had told him about some flats in Gurugrams Pyramid Society in Sector 70 that were available at throwaway prices. They met to discuss finances, said a Delhi Police officer. A source with the Delhi Police said Anya was also finding out exactly how much money Yuvraj could put together how much he had in his accounts, how much he planned to borrow from banks, and how much he was taking from friends and family. She then asked for his phone to check something. She wanted to see his password. She had already accessed his bank account statements and bank balance in the name of formalities for the sale of the plot, said a police officer. Four days later, Yuvraj was dead. Police alleged that Anya and her live-in partner, Sanyam Sachdeva, shot him dead on September 6 inside their white Creta in Gurugrams Sector 70. His body was later dumped in a drain. A police officer said the murder was linked to a post-dated cheque of Rs 90 lakh that Anya had issued to settle a cheating case involving a senior Punjab National Bank PNB official. With the money unavailable, investigators alleged, she targeted Yuvraj and fabricated a threat to draw her partner into the plan. From colleagues to partners Yuvraj, Anya and Sanyam had all worked at real estate developer Emaar, said police. Anya was allegedly fired in 2022 over financial mismanagement, while Yuvraj later left the company. She had been bringing clients to Emaar, but was also making side-deals, along with Sanyam, for extra money. When the company learnt of it, she and Sanyam were fired, said a police officer. Anya and Sanyams relationship had also begun at Emaar, said police. When she first met Sanyam in 2022, he had been married for six years and had a daughter. A police officer said she allegedly texted his wife, claiming that Sanyam was making romantic advances towards her. She also allegedly created a fake profile of his wife and showed it to Sanyam, trying to prove that she was also keeping secrets from him. Ultimately, Sanyam left his wife and daughter and started living with Anya. After being let go from Emaar, the couple went to Dehradun for over one and a half years before returning to Gurugram. Anya and Sanyam had a son. By September, Anya was facing another problem. She needed money. A cheating case According to a police officer, Anya had two cases of cheating registered against her. One of them involved the high-level PNB official, whom Anya and Sanyam had allegedly cheated of Rs 1.25 crore between 2025 and 2026. A case was registered against them at Parliament Street police station in August this year. In the FIR lodged on August 16, the PNB official said he had been served fake ED notices by Anya and Sanyam. Police said Anya then claimed strong connections in the government, and allegedly took more than Rs 1.25 crore from him, saying the money was being paid to get his name cleared. But when they demanded more money, the official examined the notices and allegedly found them forged. Anya feared further action, so she proposed an out-of-court settlement to the complainant. He demanded that she start by paying him a post-dated cheque of Rs 90 lakh, said a police officer. But Anya didnt have Rs 90 lakh in her account. Thats when Yuvraj got in touch with her, she told the police during questioning. She claimed Yuvraj had texted her about some work earlier. She knew he was doing well from his social media, said a police officer. Her plan, a police officer claimed, was to take Yuvrajs money and clear her dues with the PNB officer. The fake threat Police said Anya needed help to put her plan into motion. Police said she allegedly showed Sanyam some messages from a senior officer, threatening her to return his money. The only way to pay him back, she allegedly told Sanyam, was to kill their former colleague Yuvraj and take his money. But there was no senior officer. It was Anya posing as one she had allegedly been sending messages to herself since April from a different number to make Sanyam believe she had influential connections, said a police officer. She asked Sanyam to get a gun and two bedsheets and keep them inside their SUV. On September 6, she called Yuvraj. He was having a late lunch with his sister, Karishma, at the Golden Dragon restaurant in Lajpat Nagar, K Block. According to a police officer, Anya told Yuvraj that there was a client who was willing to invest with Adani Realty. But the deal could only be sealed if Yuvraj came then and there. Yuvraj drove his MG Astor to the location and then got into Anyas car, police said. Inside, Anya and Sanyam allegedly shot Yuvraj dead, covered his body with bedsheets and kept it in the vehicle for two days. Messages that kept a family waiting Karishma, a doctor based in Faridabad, had told The Indian Express, that her brother rushed off after the call. We were shopping for his wedding. Then he got a call and left abruptly, saying he had a meeting in Gurugram and would return by 10 pm. But Yuvraj did not return home that night. Karishma received a text from him saying he was fine and in an important meeting. The next day, I got another text. he repeated that he was fine and that he might have to go to Bengaluru, she said. Police alleged that Anya was sending the messages from Yuvrajs phone, using the password she had seen him enter during their September 2 meeting. She even sent Karishma a ticket to Bengaluru, said Sahil, Yuvrajs childhood friend. But after September 8, his phone was switched off. By then, police alleged, Anya and Sanyam dumped the body in a drain in Badshahpur. The couple then travelled to Vrindavan and several other places before reaching Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand, where they stayed in a paying guest accommodation. They were later arrested from Kainchi Dham after their vehicle was traced. A gun was recovered from them along with Yuvrajs car and phone, a police officer said. On September 11, Karishma approached the Lajpat Nagar police station and filed a complaint. On September 16, the Delhi Police learnt that a body had been found days earlier in Gurugram Sector 70 by their counterparts in the city who later cremated it after failing to identify it. The body was Yuvrajs.

articleTitle: Ahmedabad bridge meant to ease traffic ends up worsening it
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, Railway Overbridge project at Makarba, Makarba, Makarba Railway Overbridge, Makarba Railway Overbridge project, Ahmedabad news, Gujarat news, Indian express, current affairs
description: The Makarba railway overbridge that CM Bhupendra Patel inaugurated on Sept 24 lands smack at a junction on Corporate Road. The civic body has demanded an explanation from the design consultant and is scrambling to find immediate solutions to the traffic chaos that has ensued.
body_raw: The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation AMC has issued a show-cause notice to a design consultant firm involved in a railway overbridge project at Makarba that has caused traffic chaos, within two weeks of its inauguration. This traffic congestion in the rapidly growing commercial and residential area in southwestern Ahmedabad has forced the civic body to widen the connecting road to resolve the problem, and to implement immediate traffic solutions. The firm, Ahmedabad-based DELF Consulting Engineers India Pvt Ltd., is an extension of DELF-South Africa, according to its website. The company was the design consultant for the railway overbridge that Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel inaugurated on September 24 under the Phatak-mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, a campaign to free roads from railway level crossings. However, the four-lane bridge, which was meant to ease traffic snarls caused by the closure of the gates of Level Crossing 24 on the Ahmedabad-Botad broad gauge section of Western Railway, lands at a junction on Corporate Road-which has resulted in congestion and traffic chaos on the roads that connect to the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar Highway. AMC has instructed the projects design consultant, DELF Consulting Engineers India Pvt Ltd, to conduct a technical study of the current traffic situation and submit a detailed report, Dinesh Gaurav, Deputy Municipal Commissioner, Roads and Building Department, said. He said the design consultant had been instructed to analyse the root causes of the current traffic congestion and traffic flow patterns, and to submit a detailed report outlining both immediate corrective measures for the current situation and long-term solutions to permanently resolve the traffic issues. Gaurav said the design firm has been asked to explain the technical reasons behind the situation, and to compare the traffic flow now with the time when the study was conducted. Work on the bridge began in 2023. The show-cause notice says, The bridge lands in close proximity to the Corporate Road junction, leaving inadequate length for merging, weaving and dispersal of traffic. Based on the findings of the technical study and the clarifications provided by the design consultant, an appropriate technical evaluation will be carried out, and necessary further action would be taken, Gaurav said. Meanwhile, the AMC has implemented a capsule design layout to streamline traffic flow and reduce congestion at this point. Also,.AMC has undertaken the widening of the existing road from Corporate Crossroads to SG Highway to its full width. Efforts are underway to ensure that traffic flow on this route improves significantly upon the completion of this work, Gaurav said.

articleTitle: Supreme Court agrees to hear Punjab government’s plea challenging HC’s order for CBI probe into corruption allegations
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Supreme Court, Supreme Court CBI probe into corruption allegations, CBI probe into Punjab corruption allegations, Punjab corruption allegations, Punjab AAP, Prevention of Money Laundering Act, Indian express news, current affairs
description: Senior Advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for the state, mentioned the matter before Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, seeking an urgent hearing on Tuesday itself. The CJI, however, said the court will consider listing the matter for hearing on Wednesday or Thursday.
body_raw: PUNJABS AAM Aadmi Party government on Tuesday approached the Supreme Court challenging the Punjab and Haryana High Court order directing the CBI to register a case and investigate allegations made by the Enforcement Directorate ED against people linked to Chief Minister Bhagwant Manns office. Senior Advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for the state, mentioned the matter before Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, seeking an urgent hearing on Tuesday itself. The CJI, however, said the court will consider listing the matter for hearing on Wednesday or Thursday. Singh explained that in the case, under 662 of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, information was given by the Enforcement Directorate to the Punjab Director General of Police DGP towards the end of July. He said that in the Vijay Madanlal Chowdhary case, in which the SC had upheld EDs powers of arrest and seizure, it was made clear that police have to act only if there is a cognizable offence, and that too only in a situation where a large amount of cash is found and not in any routine instance. However, on October 5, the HC asked the CBI to register an FIR, he said. Seeking urgent listing, he said the CBI cant be directed to register an FIR. Singh said its a case regarding transfers, postings, etc. During election time, these kinds of cases are being trumped up. I have no problem if criminality is involved, he said. To a query as to what is the urgency, the senior counsel said There is urgency. Its a state going to polls. Its a clear case of the federal structure which is. being violated. The Punjab and Haryana HC on Monday directed the CBI to conduct a fair and transparent investigation into allegations raised in an ED communication to the police and submit its report within two months. The case is scheduled to come up before the High Court on December 7. The ED had sought registration of a case against Manns Officer on Special Duty Rajbir Singh Ghuman and his alleged associates Nitin Gohal and Bir Devinder. In its communication to the DGP under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act on July 30, the ED sought registration of a criminal case on the basis of material allegedly indicating cash-for-transfers and postings, influence over government policies and tenders, leakage of confidential government documents and other favours. According to the allegations cited by the ED, Ghuman, Gohal and Devinder had allegedly interfered in transfers and postings of government officials, government work and tender processes. The agency had also referred to material purportedly indicating attempts to influence postings, access confidential government documents and interfere in administrative approvals and other official processes. The High Court order came on a PIL filed by advocate Nikhil Saraf, based on the ED communication sent to the DGP. The court noted that the communication was received in the DGPs office on August 3 and was marked to the Punjab Bureau of Investigation, but no FIR had been registered even after two months. While directing the CBI to register a case, the HC division bench of Chief Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra and Justice Rohit Kapoor said the allegations would have to be tested during investigation and trial.

articleTitle: Sexual assault at Bagheshwar Dham: Case takes turn after DNA test
articleFeaturedImageAlt: DNA test rules out rape accused as father, man accused of raping daughter, mp man accused of raping daughter, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh High Court, Indian express news, current affairs
description: The MP High Court has now directed the Chhatarpur Superintendent of Police to constitute a special team and conduct a fresh investigation into the case.
body_raw: The case of alleged sexual assault on a 16-year-old girl at Bageshwar Dham in Madhya Pradesh has taken a turn after a forensic examination established the man accused of raping her was not the biological father of the foetus she was carrying. The MP High Court has now directed the Chhatarpur Superintendent of Police to constitute a special team and conduct a fresh investigation into the case. However, the court did not treat the forensic finding as sufficient ground to grant bail to the accused. It noted that the girl was a minor and that the material before the court indicated that she had been subjected to sexual harassment. Justice Ajay Kumar Nirankari, while dismissing the second bail application of the accused, directed the police to identify the person who allegedly sexually assaulted the minor and establish the identity of the biological father of the foetus. The court ordered that the investigation be completed within two months and appropriate action be taken. The case came up before the court after the minor, who was found to be around two months pregnant when she was medically examined during probe, subsequently underwent termination of pregnancy. The foetus was preserved and its samples, placenta tissue, and blood were sent to the State Forensic Science Laboratory, Sagar. The forensic report, dated August 29, 2026, found that the accused was not the biological father of the foetus. The HC took note of the contradiction between forensic evidence and the minors statements during trial. While the victim had initially alleged in statements the accused had forcibly raped her at Bageshwar Dham in Chhatarpur, she later did not support the prosecution case when examined.

articleTitle: Karnataka Public Service Commission job racket: ED arrests suspended KPSC chairman Shivashankarappa Sahukar, another officer
articleFeaturedImageAlt: KPSC recruitment scam, Karnataka KPSC scam, KPSC chairman daughter recruitment, Suma Sahukar income certificate case, KPSC veterinary doctor paper leak .Karnataka veterinary recruitment scam. Shivashankarappa Sahukar CID probe, KPSC question paper leak, Karnataka High Court KPSC case, KPSC corruption allegations, Basavaraj Kannale KPSC scam, Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar arrest, 400 veterinary doctors recruitment scam, Karnataka government job scam, Express investigation, KPSC recruitment controversy
description: A Bengaluru Zone official of the ED confirmed the arrest of Sahukar and Geetha on Tuesday. “Their custody will be sought after production before a special judge,” the official said
body_raw: The Enforcement Directorate on Tuesday arrested suspended chairman of Karnataka Public Service Commission KPSC Shivashankarappa S Sahukar and a member of the Commission, B V Geetha, in connection with its money laundering probe into the recruitment of veterinary officers through KPSC. The arrests came in the wake of a fresh round of searches on Tuesday at a flat where Sahukar lived in Bengaluru, and statements given to the ED in recent weeks by arrested IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar and a middleman, Basavaraj Kannale, about corruption at the KPSC. A Bengaluru Zone official of the ED confirmed the arrest of Sahukar and Geetha on Tuesday. Their custody will be sought after production before a special judge, the official said The Karnataka High Court and a special court for CID cases had earlier rejected anticipatory bail pleas of the suspended KPSC chairman while pointing out that he was the custodian of the KPSC and hence responsible for all illegal activities that occurred under his watch. Sahukar was suspended by Karnataka Governor Thaawar Chand Gehlot on August 25 over illegal recruitment of his daughter to a state government job through KPSC. He was being investigated by the Karnataka Police in connection with multiple complaints of fraud in KPSC recruitment, but had not been arrested by the state police so far. Sahukar has been accused in two specific cases of fraud the KPSC recruitment of veterinary officers for 400 vacancies in the state and the recruitment of his daughter as an industrial officer on the basis of a fake income certificate. Sahukar and KPSC were at the centre of a series of investigative reports by The Indian Express on the recruitment scam during the tenure of Sahukar, who was picked by the BJP for the KPSC chairman post in 2019 and retained by the Congress, which came to power in Karnataka in 2023. The EDs arrest of Sahukar and B V Geetha comes following statements by Gangwar on KPSC officials using preliminary selection lists to extort aspirants during multiple job recruitments done by the Commission in the last two years. Arrested middleman Basavaraj Kannale also claimed to have given crores of Rupees to KPSC officials after collecting bribes from candidates for various job recruitments, said sources. According to the sources, Gangwar told the ED during questioning that when the 13 merit list for the veterinary doctors recruitment was published on February 4, 2026, KPSC officials, including Sahukar, Geetha, Shanta Hosmani, Elfreda D Silva, among others, approached him with candidate names to seek information about their prospects, and he divulged the information. Once the merit of a candidate was known, the concerned member, official or middleman contacted the candidate and negotiated the bribe amount the higher the candidates chance of selection, the higher the amount demanded, the ED informed a special court last week.

articleTitle: Press Council of India operating at half strength, without a single working journalist or newspaper editor
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Press Council of India
description: I&B Ministry says notification of names nominated by the PCI in final stage, expected to be issued shortly
body_raw: THE COUNTRYS key media watchdog, Press Council of India PCI, has been operating at half its sanctioned strength for nearly a year now and without a single working journalist or newspaper editor. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting IB has not yet formally notified the names of 13 of the 28 PCI members, six of whom should be newspaper editors and seven should be working journalists other than editors, despite the PCI nominating them earlier this year. Ironically, the PCI remained without a chairman for nearly four months until Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, a retired Supreme Court judge, was reappointed to the post in April this year. Justice Desai had completed her previous tenure in December last year, resulting in a prolonged vacancy before her reappointment. Responding to queries from The Indian Express on the matter, the IB Ministry said it is informed that the notification of the names of the 13 members is currently at the final stage and is expected to be issued shortly, upon completion of the requisite formalities. The PCI operates under the Press Council Act, 1978, which stipulates that the Council must consist of a chairperson and 28 members, each serving a three-year term. The members include six newspaper owners, one representative from news agencies, five Members of Parliament and three persons with special knowledge or practical experience in education, science, law, literature and culture, nominated by the University Grants Commission, the Bar Council of India and the Sahitya Akademi, respectively. In addition, the Council includes six newspaper editors and seven working journalists. The Act therefore mandates the appointment of 13 newspaper editors and working journalists. However, after the 14th Press Council completed its term in October 2024, the 15th Press Council has yet to be fully constituted. At present, only 14 of the 28 members have been appointed five MPs, three nominees and six from among newspaper owners and management, aside from the chairperson. Documents accessed by The Indian Express show that the PCI has nominated the 13 members from its side in batches since last year, under Section 53a of the Press Council Act. In December last year, the PCI nominated six newspaper editors, followed by six working journalists in May this year. The seventh working journalist was nominated in July. The documents further show that the PCI sent three communications to the IB Ministry separately - dated May 25, July 2 and September 9 - requesting it to issue the Gazette notification under Section 55 of the Act. The section states that the Central Government shall notify the names of persons nominated as members in the Official Gazette, and that each nomination shall take effect from the date of notification. In its latest communication to the Ministry, dated September 9, the PCI requested that the Gazette notification for the 13 members be issued at the earliest. It said it had received communications from nominees expressing concern over the delay in officially notifying their appointments as PCI members. In the earlier communication dated July 2, the PCI asked the Ministry to expedite the notification of the 12 individuals it had nominated to the Council by that date. This is essential to enable the 15th term of the Council to become fully representative and functional so that it can discharge its regular responsibilities, the letter stated. The matter, it is learnt, is under process at the Ministrys end. The PCI has continued to hold meetings despite functioning with half its sanctioned strength. It held its last meeting in June, and another is scheduled for later this month. The issue was also raised in Parliament in February by BJD legislator Sasmit Patra, who highlighted the serious implications of the absence of a duly constituted Council and a chairperson. He urged the government to treat the matter with the seriousness it deserved and take immediate steps to appoint a chairperson and constitute the 15th Press Council. Restoring the full functioning of the PCI is essential to uphold democratic values, strengthen media accountability and reaffirm the governments commitment to a free, fair and responsible press, he said.

articleTitle: Delhi cops had protest under control, then Gandhis walked into All India Radio
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra are detained by police during a protest against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls at Akashvani Bhawan in Delhi on Tuesday. (Express Photo by Gajendra Yadav)
description: Though the Akashvani staff tried to stop them, leading to a tense stand-off, the two eventually made their way inside. “We don’t know what happened.
body_raw: As the INDIA bloc tried to make it to the Election Commission, its leaders ran into police barricades metres from the poll panels office. Soon afterwards, Opposition leaders started getting detained and herded into police buses. The march seemed all but over, and only a handful of Congress leaders remained. Just then, the Gandhi siblings pulled off an impromptu move, upending the script and taking police and their fellow Opposition leaders by surprise. Around 8 pm, police moved in to detain the Gandhis and other Opposition leaders. It all kicked off around noon when Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi climbed a barricade near the NITI Aayog office at Sansad Marg, a few hundred metres from the ECI headquarters of Nirvachan Sadan, and waved the Tricolour as cameras clicked him. Rahul then climbed down as police began detaining MPs sitting on the road. Minutes later, he dashed back towards a bus parked near Akashvani Bhavan, the headquarters of All India Radio, where his sister Priyanka Gandhi Vadra was seated, catching many Opposition MPs, including some from the Congress, by surprise. As Rahul was about to get into the bus, the siblings locked eyes with each other. Priyanka got down and, along with her brother, walked past policemen towards Akashvani Bhavan, leaving the cops also surprised. Though the Akashvani staff tried to stop them, leading to a tense stand-off, the two eventually made their way inside. We dont know what happened. This was not part of the plan, said a Congress leader. A Congress MP outside Akashvani said, Only the two of them know what they had in mind when they walked in. Congress leaders credited the Gandhis with derailing polices attempts to end the protest. The protest would have been over had they not done this, said a leader. Congress leaders said Rahul made the plan on the fly to use Akashvani as a shortcut to Nirvachan Sadan, which is located near the back gate of the broadcasters headquarters. However, police closed the gate, leaving the Congress leaders to camp on Akashvanis premises. Delhi Police and Rapid Action Force personnel have been stationed outside the Bhavan. While Opposition sources claimed Priyanka was leading negotiations with senior government officials - insisting the protest will continue until they are allowed to meet Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi - the Home Ministry dismissed it as fake. Around 2.30 pm, as reporters pushed their microphones through the grille, Rahul told them from inside the premises, I dont care what the BJP says. Im standing here to protect democracy. What has been done to the country is treason. Be it PM Modi, Amit Shah, the RSS chief, or Gyanesh Kumar, none will be spared. Until reports last came in, Congress leaders led by the siblings were carrying on with the sit-in, with Opposition MPs such as Derek OBrien and Mahua Moitra of the Mamata Banerjee-led All India Trinamool Congress also joining them at the Bhavan. Unmoved. Unfazed. We will not budge until our demands are met. We will not rest until our democracy is saved from the Vote Chors, K C Venugopal posted on X.

articleTitle: Andhra government declares drought in 21 districts; 283 mandals ‘severely affected’
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Andhra government declares drought in districts, Andhra government declares drought, Andhra drought. Andhra Pradesh drought. Andhra Pradesh government, Indian express news, current affairs
description: A high-level Committee on Drought, in a meeting held on September 30, recommended early declaration of drought in 21 of the state’s 26 districts, instead of waiting for the October 31 deadline for declaration of the 2026 Kharif season drought.
body_raw: The Andhra Pradesh government has declared 388 of its 688 mandals - across 21 districts - as drought affected with 283 being classified as severely affected and 105 moderately affected. A government order was issued to this effect by the Revenue Disaster Management Department on October 1 for the South-West Monsoon 2026 Kharif season. A high-level Committee on Drought, in a meeting held on September 30, recommended early declaration of drought in 21 of the states 26 districts, instead of waiting for the October 31 deadline for declaration of the 2026 Kharif season drought. The order comes amid a sharp deficit in rainfall across the state, amplified by prevailing El Nino conditions. Due to a 53.4 rainfall deficit recorded during the months of JuneAugust, 2026, and the prevailing El Nino conditions, by taking into consideration the relevant drought indicators based on data available for the period from June to August, 2026, it is proposed to undertake an early declaration of drought for Kharif-2026. An average rainfall of 197.6 mm has been received against the normal rainfall of 424.3 mm from June 1 to August 31, the order states. The declaration was made as per the Manual for Drought Management, 2016 issued by the Government of India. The 21 districts are Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli, Kakinada, East Godavari, Eluru, Krishna, NTR district, Guntur, Bapatla, Palnadu, Prakasam, Markapuram, Kurnool, Nandyal, Ananthapuramu, Sri Satya Sai, YSR Kadapa, Annamayya and Chittoor. The YSRCP slammed the government for not including Nellore district, claiming that several mandals in the district received less rainfall. Referring to the drought-like conditions in the state, Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu on Monday said that interlinking of Godavari and Cauvery river systems can make southern states drought-free. While drought conditions prevail, 2,000 TMC of river water is flowing into the sea. If at least 200 TMC of Godavari floodwater is utilised, the Rayalaseema region will flourish with abundant greenery and crops, he said, while launching the Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 - Amarajeevi Jaladhara programmes in Proddatur in YSR Kadapa district. Former Agriculture Minister Kurasala Kannababu and YSRCP State General Secretary Gadikota Srikanth Reddy alleged that government delayed drought declaration despite severe conditions since the first week of September. Kannababu said Rayalaseema region was bearing the brunt of the rainfall deficit with 186 of the 388 drought-declared mandals located in the region and 159 of the 283 severe-drought mandals also situated there.

articleTitle: Scheduled call with Putin to discuss possible case of pneumonic plague in Russia: Trump
articleFeaturedImageAlt: United States President Donald Trump. (Photo: AP)
description: Asked what the U.S. intelligence community was saying about the case, Trump said the U.S. is in “very deep discussions” on the topic. “We’ll be able to report about it, probably tomorrow,” Trump said.
body_raw: President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he has a call scheduled with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss a possible case of plague at a Siberian research institute. Speaking to reporters at the White House, Trump said he would be talking with Putin about the case very soon. Health authorities are investigating after the death of an employee at an anti-plague institute, which authorities attributed to pneumonia with an unknown cause. Asked what the U.S. intelligence community was saying about the case, Trump said the U.S. is in very deep discussions on the topic. Well be able to report about it, probably tomorrow, Trump said. The World Health Organization on Tuesday said the case presents a very low risk outside Russia. The United Nations agency said it was in contact with Russian authorities following reports of the death last week of a woman who worked at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East. On Monday, Trump said the U.S. would be willing to help Russia with the situation. Its a rough disease. You know, thats a disease we used to be able to control, but somehow those microbes have gotten stronger and smarter. Theyre like an army, Trump told reporters at the White House. The call also comes as the Trump administration faces an Oct. 18 deadline to decide which Russian entities, if any, it will sanction under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which Trump signed into law on Sept. 18. Ukraine has given the administration and Congress a wish list of Russian companies, vessels and individuals it would like to see hit with U.S. sanctions under that law.

articleTitle: Kashmiri filmmaker Arfat Sheikh detained by ICE en route to ‘Art as Resistance’ panel
articleFeaturedImageAlt: arfat sheikh
description: The 42-year-old Sheikh has been kept at the Caroline Detention Facility in Virginia and was expected to appear before an immigration judge on Tuesday.
body_raw: An award-winning Kashmiri filmmaker has been detained by the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement ICE, the Independent reported, citing his friends and supporters. ICE detained Arfat Sheikh at the Washington Dulles airport on September 24 while he was on his way to attend an Art as Resistance panel, scheduled to take place at Busboys and Poets in Washington DC, the Independent reported. Sheikh had just stepped off his flight from California when the ICE agents surrounded him and took him into custody without a warrant despite him presenting his immigration paperwork, his friends alleged. The 42-year-old Sheikh has been kept at the Caroline Detention Facility in Virginia and was expected to appear before an immigration judge on Tuesday. He was travelling with author Tara Dorabji, who was one of the speakers at the September 26 panel, where she would address the experiences of the survivors of torture in Kashmir, Independent reported. ICE has not yet responded to the issue. On September 24th, 2026, our friend and filmmaker, Arfat Sheikh was unlawfully detained by ICE coming off a plane at Dulles Airport IAD. FreeArfatSheikh 15 - Free Arfat Sheikh freearfatsheikh October 6, 2026 His friends, colleagues, Americans, and family have launched a campaign to raise 50,000 to pay for his legal representation. About Arfat Sheikh Arfat Sheikh is a Kashmiri filmmaker, living in the US for the past few years. According to the Independent, his first feature film, Saffron Kingdom, which won him accolades, explores conflict, displacement, and identity in Kashmir. The film won him accolades at several independent film festivals. At the Teaneck International Film Festival, 2025, Sheikh was named an Emerging Filmmaker Activist.

articleTitle: Most goals in international football: Messi ends Argentina career as second highest scorer
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Messi scored a penalty in his final appearance for Argentina on Tuesday night. (AP Photo)
description: Messi ended his career as the second-highest scorer among all men, only behind Cristiano Ronaldo (146).
body_raw: Lionel Messi brought the curtains down on his sensational 21-year Argentina career on Tuesday night in Buenos Aires during a 3-0 win over Benin. And in customary Messi fashion, the Argentina talisman did not miss the scoresheet, having secured an assist and converted a penalty to lead a breezy win for the 2026 World Cup runners-up. Messi played his first game on August 17, 2005, an infamous debut that lasted only 90 seconds after he copped a red card against Hungary. Messi leaves the international stage as the most decorated figure in Argentine football history. His 66 assists, increased by one during his final game, is an all-time record in international football. His roll of honours includes the Beijing 2008 Olympic gold medal, the FIFA World Cup 2022 title, back-to-back Copa America trophies in 2021 and 2024, and the 2022 Finalissima. He appeared in a record-tying six World Cups alongside Ronaldo. At the 2026 edition where Argentina finished runners-up, Messi produced one of his best World Cup campaigns, smashing 8 goals and 4 assists. He finished with 21 goals in his career, the second-highest of all time at the showpiece event, behind Kylian Mbappe. articleTitle: UPI, government salaries may be used to measure growth in health, education services
articleFeaturedImageAlt: upi payments
description: Currently being released by the statistics ministry on a trial basis, the Index of Services Production is the services sector counterpart to the Index of Industrial Production, which is a key gauge of industrial activity in the country.
body_raw: The statistics ministry is considering using UPI payments data and salaries paid by the government to help measure the growth of education, health, and public administration and defence services. This would increase the services covered by the new Index of Services Production ISP, the ministry said on Tuesday. The proposed use of UPI data for the ISP comes despite a sub-committee of the ministrys Advisory Committee on National Accounts Statistics deciding against it as an input in the calculation of Indias GDP, noting that payments transaction data is not yet stable, with many people yet to move to UPI from cash. Once the UPI transaction data get stabilised, it may be explored for possible inclusion as an indicator in the estimation of PFCE, the report of the sub-committee, released in February, had said. PFCE is Private Final Consumption Expenditure and the biggest component of GDP when its measured as the sum of various types of spending. However, the statistics ministry said on Tuesday the UPI is entering a new phase of market maturity and growth in transaction values and volumes is showing a clear stabilising trend after several years of hyper-growth. Looking forward, the trend strongly suggests that UPI is transitioning into a highly mature and resilient utility. Future growth is likely to flatten into a stable band, the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation MoSPI said. UPI completed 10 years of existence earlier this year. In an approach paper to widen the ISPs coverage-released on an experimental basis starting July-MoSPI said payments made by UPI for various types of schools, universities, other educational and health and medical services can be used to gauge the private sector aspect of these two categories. Meanwhile, these services provided by the public sector are proposed to be measured by the salaries paid by the government for various staff. Comments on the approach paper are invited by October 16. Identification of UPI payments for these categories will be done by the Merchant Category Codes. For instance, the merchant code for taxi cabs and limousines is 4121. Meanwhile, salaries for relevant government staff are to be taken from the Public Financial Management System PFMS, which captures budget provisions and expenditures incurred by the government under different heads. For public administration and defence, which are not market activities and hence cant be measured through their transaction values, MoSPI has proposed adding together the compensation paid to relevant employees and operational expenses incurred in the provision of these services. According to data from the National Payments Corporation of India NPCI, Rs 25,635 crore was spent via UPI on education in August, while the figure for the hospitals segment was Rs 16,976 crore. Meanwhile, Rs 17,487 crore was spent on government services. These three categories constituted 2.9, 1.9, and 2, respectively of the entire months Person-to-Merchant UPI payments of almost Rs 9 lakh crore. These three sub-sectors made up almost a fifth of the entire services sectors Gross Value Added GVA in 2024-25 education around 7, human health and residential care around 3, and public administration and defence almost 11. The ISP is the service counterpart to the Index of Industrial Production and currently comprises 19 sub-sectors covering approximately 60 of the sectors GVA in 2024-25, which is the base year for this new data series. Health, education, and public administration and defence were not initially included in the index as MoSPI hadnt finalised a method to measure their output. Following their inclusion, the ISP will cover around 78 of the services sectors GVA. The remaining 22 or so comes from ownership of dwellings, the Reserve Bank of India, and gambling and betting, among other activities. These will continue to be excluded from the index. The ISP aims to fill a key gap in Indias official statistics until now, there has been no official monthly measure of the services sectors performance, with private sector firm SP Globals services Purchasing Managers Index being the only one. This is despite services being the largest contributor to Indias economy, making up more than half of it for the last decade and a half or so. Industry, meanwhile, makes up less than a third of the GVA.

articleTitle: Barricades, Sting, and ‘Khan Chacha’: How the Gandhis kept protest going
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Priyanka Gandhi climbs and opens the gates of Kingway Camp, where his brother was detained and Rahul Gandhi climbs barricades during a protest in New Delhi. (Source: Screengrab/ Express photo by Abhinav Saha)
description: Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi bypassed police barricades into Akashvani Bhawan, transforming the INDIA bloc’s march to the Election Commission into a day-long standoff.
body_raw: What appeared to be the end of the INDIA blocs protest to the Election Commission took an unexpected turn after Gandhi siblings found a way past the police barricades and into the Akashvani Bhawan premises. The Opposition leaders had set out from Parliament Street to the Election Commission headquarters, barely 300 metres away, demanding action against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of electoral irregularities and the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. But the march was stopped by Delhi Police, with barricades put up on the routes. Several Opposition MPs were also detained and taken away in buses. As the detentions mounted, only a few Congress leaders remained at the protest site. Rahul climbs barricade The drama began around noon when Rahul Gandhi climbed atop a police barricade near the NITI Aayog office on Sansad Marg. He was seen holding and waving the Tricolour flag as cameras captured the moment. He later climbed down as police began detaining MPs who were sitting on the road and protesting. But the question is, was Rahul done with that? No. As detained MPs were being taken away, he suddenly moved towards a bus parked near Akashvani Bhawan, where Priyanka Gandhi Vadra was seated. They walked into Akashvani Bhawan As Rahul Gandhi was about to get into the bus, he and Priyanka exchanged a glance. Priyanka then got down. The two siblings, along with their supporters, walked past the policemen and entered the Akashvani Bhawan premises, taking the protest to a new location and leaving the police confused and scrambling to respond. Rahul was seen with Congress leaders K C Venugopal, Deepender Singh Hooda, Charanjeet Singh Channi, Pawan Khera, Imran Pratapgarhi and Praniti Shinde. The leaders settled under a tree inside the premises and insisted that they be allowed to meet the Election Commission. We represent the people of the country. we are their voice, Rahul told reporters. I am not interested in what the BJP says. I am standing here to protect democracy in the country. Along with me, 300 Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha MPs had come and they are also trying to protect democracy, the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha added. From protest to break Even as the confrontation with police continued, the Gandhi siblings were seen taking a breather during the prolonged protest. At one point, Rahul offered Priyanka Sting energy drink. She was seen smelling it before taking a sip. Later during the protest Rahul was seen eating a roll from Khan Chacha while Priyanka sat beside him. The informal breaks came as the Congress leaders continued their sit-in and maintained that they would not leave until they were allowed to meet the Election Commission. Priyanka Gandhi Vadra also told a police officer that the inconvenience to commuters was being caused by the Delhi Polices repeated barricading of roads and routes across the city. She argued that since the protest began, police had been blocking multiple routes and even restricting access around metro stations, leading to traffic snarls and disruptions. The inconvenience, she said, was not being caused by Congress workers or those protesting on the streets, but by the police arrangements put in place to contain the agitation. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Mojo Story themojostory Gandhis face off with Delhi police Their protest eventually escalated, with police moving in to remove Rahul and other leaders from the Akashvani Bhawan premises. Rahul was forcibly removed and briefly detained as the protest continued elsewhere. But Priyanka remained at the centre of the agitation. At one point, she was seen climbing the gated premises at Kingsway Camp, where Rahul had been taken after being removed from the protest site. She opened the gates, after which Congress workers entered the premises. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Mojo Story themojostory As the protest stretched till late evening, Rahul said the Opposition MPs would continue to press for a meeting with the election commissioners. They will have to meet us. The MPs were disrespected. We have not done anything wrong. We want to go to the election commissioners and ask questions of them and tell them that they have done vote chori, Gandhi said. But on the other hand, according to EC it had not received any request from Congress or any political party seeking a meeting. By then, what had started as an INDIA bloc march from Parliament Street to the poll panel had turned into a day-long confrontation, with the Gandhis repeatedly defying police attempts to contain the protest.

articleTitle: Nearly 2 lakh fewer voters: Meet Chandigarh residents missing after SIR
articleFeaturedImageAlt: martyr mother
description: Chandigarh’s final electoral roll has 4,60,209 electors, against 6,59,805 in the 2024 General Election roll — a net reduction of 1,99,596 electors, or 30.25 per cent.
body_raw: A mother lost her only son following an encounter in Jammu and Kashmir. Another family has spent three decades serving chai and paranthas to generations of Chandigarh students and voted for decades here. Yet, after the Special Intensive Revision SIR, all of these and more have found their names absent in the electoral roles of a city they have called home for decades. Chandigarhs final electoral roll has 4,60,209 electors, against 6,59,805 in the 2024 General Election roll - a net reduction of 1,99,596 electors, or 30.25 per cent. Notices have been sent to people with a call for personal hearing. Veena Sharma, 86, lost her only son, Captain Rohit Kaushal, who was killed while fighting militants in an encounter in Doda district of Jammu and Kashmir on November 11, 1995. Captain Kaushal was awarded the Shaurya Chakra for gallantry. The 86-year-old was flagged for deletion during the SIR after a discrepancy was found in her surname in older electoral records. A notice was served by the jurisdictional Booth Level Officer BLO, asking her to appear for a personal hearing. Sharma has been staying in Vrindavan for the past several months following the death of her husband and was not in Chandigarh when the notice was issued. Her son-in-law, Vinod Vashisht, then stepped in. In the 2002 electoral rolls, she had Sharma as her surname. At that time, they were staying in Sector 22 and after having moved to Sector 43, her vote showed the surname Kaushal. But the change had not been made in her older electoral record. And she was served a notice with calls that she has to personally attend the hearing, Vashisht told The Indian Express. What troubled the family was that Sharma was being asked to travel to Chandigarh despite being 86 and having several government documents establishing her identity. She is 86 years old and has been a voter in Chandigarh for more than 40 years. She is currently staying in Vrindavan and could not simply be asked to travel to Chandigarh again and again just to establish something that is already supported by her documents, Vashisht, who is also patron of the Shaheed Capt Rohit Kaushal Charitable Trust, said. He said Sharmas Aadhaar, PAN, pensioner card and passport all carry her present surname and are linked to her registered mobile number. I had to repeatedly approach the election authorities and explain that this was an elderly woman and the issue was only a surname mismatch. She was being asked to appear in person in Chandigarh, but why should an 86-year-old woman have to undertake such a journey when her Aadhaar, PAN, pensioner card and passport were already there, he said. Vashisht eventually appeared before the BLO and local election officials are now examining the case. But the episode, he said, raises a larger question about elderly voters who may not have family members to pursue such cases. She had already given her only son to the nation. It was painful to see that today she was being made to struggle to establish her right to vote. The process makes us wonder about elderly voters who may not have someone to take up their case, he said. 30 years of serving chai, paranthas, now an entire family missing from the rolls For more than three decades, the chai-parantha stall in Sector 35-D has been part of Chandigarhs student life. Generations of students, PG residents and college-goers have spent time there over steaming cups of tea and plates of parathas. But for the family that has run the stall since 1997, that three-decade connection with Chandigarh has not translated into their names remaining on the electoral rolls. Manoj, 35, who lives with his family in Sector 42-B, Attawa, said his wife, brothers Anil and Krishna, and mother have all been left out of the rolls. His father, too, had been a Chandigarh voter. We came here for work and the BLO told us that our house was locked and they could not find us. They have struck off the names of our entire family - my wife, my brothers Anil and Krishna and my mother. My father also voted here only. This stall was started by him in 1997, Manoj said. For him, the deletion is difficult to understand because voting in Chandigarh has been part of the familys life for decades. I am born here. my brothers are born here.. we have been voting since we were 18. My father also voted here, he said. Manoj, who currently lives on rent, questioned why being a tenant should become a reason for exclusion from the electoral rolls. Just because we stay on rent does not mean we should be excluded from the rolls. We have been living and working here for years. I have asked the BLO to come and verify us at our home, but he does not come, he said. He said he also has documents to establish his address. My government license that is given to me for this stall, my Aadhaar Card and all my documents have my address. Still, our name has been struck off. Why were all the names removed? They should come and verify us, he said. How can they ask us for the 2002 roll? I was just six For Karanbir Singh - a lawyer - the demand to establish an electoral link to a 2002 roll when he was just six, has turned into a family ordeal. Karanbir, 30, his wife Rupal Trivedi, sister Harkriti Singh, domestic help Neema Rawat and her son Pankaj Rawat were all asked to undergo verification. He said all five members had submitted the required documents before the BLO and filed their SIR forms within the stipulated time. He said he submitted his own form on June 24. Yet, he later received a notice stating that his vote had been cancelled and was called for a hearing on August 4, where he had to submit documents again to get his name restored. What particularly puzzled him was the demand to establish the familys electoral link with the 2002 roll. I was six. My sister wasnt even born. How can they ask us for the 2002 roll, he asked. The family was later called to Sector 17 for cross-verification of their documents. For Karanbir, the process meant taking time off work, travelling to the designated centre and waiting in long queues - despite having already submitted the required paperwork. There was hardly any clear information about where to go or what exactly had to be done. The place was severely understaffed and people were standing in queues for hours, he said. Describing the scene at Sector 17, Karanbir said, It honestly looked like a complete fish market.

articleTitle: Google fights 1 billion UK lawsuit over app store fees in latest Big Tech case
articleFeaturedImageAlt: The logo of Google is seen outside Google Bay View facilities during the Made by Google event in Mountain View, California, US, August 13, 2024. (Image: Reuters/Manuel Orbegozo)
description: The trial at London's Competition ‌Appeal Tribunal follows similar cases against Apple and Sony over their App Store and PlayStation Store.
body_raw: Google was accused of abusing its dominance to levy excessive commissions on app developers, as a mass consumer lawsuit worth over 1 billion 1.33 billion began in London on Tuesday. The case - brought on behalf of around 20 million consumers who bought apps through Googles Play Store, or paid for in-app purchases and subscriptions between 2015 and this July - is the latest brought in Britain against Big Tech. Lawyers representing consumer advocate Liz Coll, who is leading the claim, say Google used its dominant position to charge commissions of up to 30 on purchases of apps through its Play Store, as well as on in-app purchases and subscriptions. They argue that those excessive commissions were passed on by app developers to consumers, citing as an example that when Google sold YouTube Premium through Apples App Store it also decided to pass on the commission it was charged. But Googles parent Alphabet is fighting the lawsuit, which a spokesperson said ignores the degree of choice the Android platform gives consumers and that it charges some of the lowest fees in the market. The tech giants lawyers, who said Colls case was unfounded, argued the Play Store faces strong competitive constraints both on the developer and consumer sides, including from Apples App Store and other alternative platforms. The trial at Londons Competition Appeal Tribunal follows similar cases against Apple and Sony over their App Store and PlayStation Store, both of which cited commissions of up to 30. Colls case also comes after years of regulatory scrutiny and litigation over Googles app store practices, including a long-running battle with Fortnite maker Epic Games, whose London lawsuit was due to be heard alongside Colls. In March, Google and Epic reached a worldwide settlement under which Google said it would expand billing options and cut developer fees. Last month, Google also settled another lawsuit for 260 million, which was brought on behalf of app developers, without making any admission of liability or wrongdoing.

articleTitle: Messi’s farewell speech: ‘I don’t want to leave, not being with Argentina hurts’
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Messi shared an emotional speech after his final Argentina appearance in Buenos Aires. (AP Photo)
description: His international debut 21 years ago against Hungary lasted 90 seconds. After 90 minutes on Tuesday night, Messi capped his Argentina career as its top goal-scorer and highest assist-provider.
body_raw: Messi had one final chapter of gilded magic left in his boots Tuesday night. In his farewell appearance in an Argentina shirt in a packed El Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires, the 39-year-old produced a goal and two assists to lead the hosts to a 3-0 win over Benin. Emotions, expectedly, ran high. The tears of not wearing the sky-blue and white shirt again and the ecstasy of blasting the ball into the net one final time, nearly conjuring up another free-kick pearler, the Rosario-born superstar had it all one final time. The eight-time Ballon dOr winner, Argentina received a raucous applause in the 10th minute, the number that glittered on the back of his shirt, as it did in another era with Diego Maradona. His international debut 21 years ago against Hungary lasted 90 seconds after a red card. After 90 minutes of passionate football on Tuesday night, Messi capped his career as the second-highest international goal scorer 126 and the most assists 67, the last of which came in the 48th minute as he provided for Nicolas Otamendi. For 20 years, even through the worst moments, I never stopped fighting, pushing forward, giving everything I had and wanting to be here, Messi said in an emotional post-match speech. Not coming here anymore and no longer being with the Argentina National Team is going to hurt a lot. If it were up to me, I would love to be here for my entire life, because playing for Argentina is the most beautiful thing there is. Messi Not coming anymore will be very painful. I swear, I would like to come here all my life because playing for the Argentine national team is the most beautiful thing that can happen to you. - Kalshi FC KalshiFC October 7, 2026 I think Im talking more than ever today because I simply dont want this moment to end, Messi said. After the World Cup dream eluded him on four occasions in 2006, 2010, 2014 and 2018, Messi and Co. produced a month of superlative football en route to the crown in Qatar in 2022. Messis men nearly secured a dream title defence earlier this year, only to be stopped at the hurdle against a rugged Spanish contingent. Age or the enduring American heat did not deter Messi until then, having recorded eight goals and four assists. But I think the time has come for me to retire. The last World Cup took a lot out of us after everything we went through. We arrived in the final with just enough left in us, but we fought until the very end, like we always did. We came very close to winning it again, and despite everything that was said about us, nothing strange happened. The match against England took a lot out of us because we gave absolutely everything. Messis Last Tango was played with members of Argentinas FIFA World Cup 2022-winning squad and their families on hand to mark the occasion. In 2022, we had the dream of fulfilling not only my dream, but the dream of an entire country becoming world champions again. And we did it. We won the World Cup, the Copa Amrica, the Finalissima. Im incredibly grateful for everything I experienced with this National Team, Messi added. The Argentina captain hailed the warrior-mindset of his teammates that powered back to world football dominance this decade and helped him fulfill his childhood World Cup dream. But this journey wasnt only about 2022 or this last World Cup. So many teammates fought alongside me for this shirt long before we finally became world champions. Never doubt how much every one of them fought and gave for Argentina. It was a privilege and an honor to share the pitch with all of my teammates and to share so much of our lives together away from football. Every time we stepped onto the pitch, I knew we could compete against anyone because I had warriors beside me who were willing to leave absolutely everything out there. To achieve the biggest things, you need a strong group. And its during the most difficult moments that you truly discover what kind of team you have. Thats one of the biggest reasons we were able to achieve everything we did. They helped me become a world champion. I also want to thank the people. I was lucky enough to play in so many cities across Argentina, and everywhere I went, I received an incredible amount of love. Here, in this stadium, I experienced one of the happiest days of my life our first match at home after becoming world champions. It was beautiful. And today might be one of the saddest because Im standing here saying goodbye. Im going to miss all of you so much, but Ill always be on your side. Ill be supporting these boys and everyone who comes after them. Messi also remembered his father, Jorge, who passed away last month. There are so many emotions today, but the first person I think about is my father. There are so many emotions going through me right now. Im surely forgetting many things I would like to say because this is a very difficult moment for me. The first person who comes to my mind is my dad. Im going to miss playing here so much. articleTitle: Eva Marie Saint dies at 102: Legendary actor won Oscar for debut role in On the Waterfront
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Eva Marie Saint dies at 102: She won an Oscar for her debut role opposite Marlin Brando in On The Waterfront.
description: Eva Marie Saint, whose acting work lasted well into her 90s, died at her home in Los Angeles on Tuesday, confirmed family representative Jeff Sanderson.
body_raw: Eva Marie Saint, the pale, willowy actor who won an Academy Award for her first movie, On the Waterfront, and starred opposite Cary Grant in the Alfred Hitchcock thriller North by Northwest, has died. She was 102. Saint, whose acting work lasted well into her 90s, died at her home in Los Angeles on Tuesday, confirmed family representative Jeff Sanderson. Eva Marie Saints memorable debut Saint had one of the most spectacular debuts in Hollywood history, as the love interest of Marlon Brandos tormented Terry Malloy in On the Waterfront, and her first trip to the Academy Awards was memorable too. Pregnant with her first child, Saint accepted her Oscar from Frank Sinatra and smilingly murmured a unique winners speech I think I may have the baby right here. Her son, Darrell, was born two days later. The award for the 1954 classic made her an instant star, but she soon astonished Hollywood with a firm independence that would mark her career. She refused offers of studio contracts and declined chances to follow up on her great success, explaining that she was taking time off to become acquainted with her new son. A daughter, Laurette, was born in 1958. In her first decade in Hollywood, Saint appeared in a mere seven films. She declined such top-level productions as The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit with Gregory Peck, Summer and Smoke with Laurence Harvey, and The Rainmaker with Burt Lancaster. She credited her husband, TV and stage director Jeffrey Hayden, with persuading her to star in Hitchcocks North by Northwest, the classic 1959 thriller in which Saint plays a spy who seduces Grant, but ends up falling for him. I vividly remember him saying, Honey, I think you should find a quiet spot. Ill take care of the children and I want you to really think about this and reread this script, she told Vanity Fair in 2014. He was so right. And thats what husbands are for. Instead of being put off by her selectivity, studios continued offering her starring roles in such films as Exodus with Newman, Raintree County Elizabeth Taylor, Montgomery Clift, and All Fall Down with Warren Beatty. She turned more to television in the 1970s and enjoyed renewed popularity in the 1980s as the mother of Cybill Shepherd in the hit sitcom Moonlighting and as Tom Hanks mother in the comedy Nothing in Common. She won an Emmy for the 1990 miniseries People Like Us, and had roles in such 21st century movies as Because of Winn-Dixie, Superman Returns, and Winters Tale, adapted from Mark Helprins novel of the same name. In 2021, she played Marisa Tomeis aunt in the brief audio play The Bus Ride, part of The Pack Podcast. Saint was married to Hayden for 65 years, until his death in 2016. Eva Marie Saints life before becoming an actor When Saint emerged in the public consciousness, many believed her theatrical-sounding name must have been invented. She was born with it on July 4, 1924, in Newark, New Jersey. The family moved to Delmar, a small town near Albany, New York, where her father was a Goodrich Rubber Co. manager. Evas goal was to become a third-grade teacher like her mother, but at Bowling Green State University in Ohio, she tried out for a play and won the leading role. After graduation, she lived with her parents and began hunting for acting jobs in Manhattan. After a fruitless year, she landed a two-line role as a telephone operator on a radio drama, and was soon working steadily on soap operas and nighttime dramas, appearing for two years as Claudia on One Mans Family. Network television was booming in the early 1950s, and her looks and dramatic sense made her a favourite with casting people and producers. A critical turn in Saints career came when she auditioned before Elia Kazan, and was accepted into the Actors Studio, which shaped a generation of method-actor stars. She credited acting coach Lee Strasberg with helping her overcome her shyness. Lee Strasberg, when he got to know me a little bit, gave me a scene to do where I had to cry in front of my peers, she told The Santa Barbara Independent in 2009. I worried about it, I worked on it, I tried to use what I was learning at the studio. I finally did the scene, and I cried, and my peers were crying with me. It was just an incredible moment for me. Saint was rejected for the single female role in the play Mister Roberts, but was hired to understudy the actor chosen, Jocelyn Brando, Marlons sister. In six frustrating months Saint never got to substitute for Brando. She finally made it to Broadway in A Trip to Bountiful, which she had played on television. Also Read When Jeffrey Archer called Bollywood bunch of thieves for stealing his bestseller plots Kazan invited her to try out for the female lead in On the Waterfront by improvising a scene with Brando. She was told to try to stop a young man from entering her apartment. She told the Los Angeles Times in 2001 All I know is that Marlon got in the door and turned on the music. We started dancing. He flicked my skirt. Kazan saw the sparks fly, and thats how I got the part.

articleTitle: Claude comes to Google Workspace: Here’s how to edit Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Claude for Google Workspace
description: With the new feature, users can easily access Claude by opening a sidebar next to their Google file.
body_raw: Anthropic on Tuesday, October 6, announced an expansion of its Claude AI-powered services into Google Workspace, enabling users to work with the AI chatbot on Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. It also lets users create and edit Google files directly from their Claude chat window. Claude for Google Workspace has been released in public beta for all paid Claude plans. What is Claude for Google Workspace? With the new feature, users can access Claude by opening a sidebar next to their Google file. This eliminates the need for users to constantly switch between apps or browser tabs when they are working. Once Claude is accessed, it can read the Google Doc, Sheet, or Slide that is open, see which text, cells, or slides have been selected, and make changes directly in the file. Google Docs In Docs, Claude can fix a sentence or restyle a heading in place without changing the formatting. It can also propose edits to larger docs as suggestion cards in the sidebar. Claude can also be used to generate executive summaries and create tables. Google Sheets In Sheets, Claude can write formulas, build pivot tables, and native Sheets charts, and add new tabs. Users can also attach source files and, for instance, ask for a Q3 budget vs. actuals report with a tab for each team and a summary chart. Google Slides In Slides, Claude can build new slides matching the rest of the decks layouts and themes, so they match the rest of the deck. It can also flag elements that overlap or run off the slide, or text thats hard to read. There are two modes under which Claude works with Google files. In the default Ask before edits mode, each change appears as an approval card with a summary and Claude waits for the users approval to make the edit. In Accept all edits mode, Claude works through the task and applies changes without stopping. How to access Google files within Claude When a user signs into their Claude account, the sidebar will have the same models, connectors, and skills they use in Claude. This is helpful for those who, for instance, save a quarterly business review QBR deck as a skill by pulling data from Salesforce and recent call notes from Google Drive. Their team can then build the next deck following the same format and steps. Users also now have in-chat access to Google files. To use this feature, Paste a Google file link or ask for a Google doc, sheet, or deck. On supported setups it will open in a pane beside the users conversation. Claudes access matches a users existing Google sharing permissions, as per Anthropic. How to use Claude for Google Workspace If you are a Claude subscriber and want the AI assistant to work better with your Google files, follow these steps -Install Claude for Google Workspace from the Google Workspace Marketplace, -Open a file and go to Extensions Claude Open Claude. -Admins can deploy it to their domain or selected groups from the Google Admin console. -To edit Google files from Claude, turn on the Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides connectors. -On Team and Enterprise plans, an owner or primary owner needs to enable the connectors first.

articleTitle: OpenAI releases 372 groups of math results from unreleased frontier AI model
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Reactions have been mixed, with excitement over AI’s math skills and questions about how the results should be checked and credited.(Image: Reuters)
description: OpenAI has released hundreds of mathematical results generated by an unreleased frontier AI model, including work on long-standing problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science.
body_raw: After a series of advances in mathematical research, OpenAI on Tuesday, October 6, announced that it was releasing a broad range of new mathematical results produced by one of its internal frontier models. The announcement comes weeks after the company claimed that its model had resolved the NavierStokes existence and smoothness problem, one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems. The Sam Altman-led AI startup has released 722 manuscripts spanning 372 groups of results, which the company said include solutions to, or significant progress on, hundreds of open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science. The results have been published in a GitHub repository with protocols for paper revisions and citations. The company also said that to improve how it shares results with the broader math community, it has been consulting an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence at the Institute for Advanced Study. The group is helping the company develop best practices for releasing AI-generated mathematical research. OpenAIs earlier claim about the NavierStokes problem sparked both excitement and criticism from mathematicians, particularly over how AI-generated mathematical results should be verified and credited. What does it mean? The release highlights the growing ability of AI systems to tackle mathematical research. OpenAI said the internal frontier model was given about 4,000 mathematical problems, with the average result requiring computing equivalent to around three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking. The company has also published 10 summaries showing how the model approached selected problems. Many of the proofs have been formalised using Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical proofs to be checked by computers. OpenAI said it will continue adding more formalised proofs to the repository. According to Scientific American, nearly all of the newly released results were produced by a single AI agent responding to a single prompt. This differs from OpenAIs earlier NavierStokes effort, which involved a large swarm of AI agents and reportedly millions of dollars in computing resources. The scale of the release has also raised questions about how AI-generated mathematics should be verified and credited. Researchers have called for greater transparency, independent verification and proper acknowledgement of previous human work. OpenAI has consulted an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence at the Institute for Advanced Study on these issues. The company said its latest release was informed by the groups recommendations and includes protocols for revising and citing the papers. The company also said it plans to continue testing its most advanced models on mathematics and other scientific problems, arguing that AI could eventually give researchers new tools for making discoveries.

body_raw: Ukraine hit an oil tanker off Russias Black Sea coast on Tuesday evening Oct 6, carrying an all-Indian crew, triggering a huge fire and a cloud of black smoke. Russias transport ministry said that a Liberian-flagged tanker was attacked by naval drones and that crude oil is burning openly in the waters of the Black Sea. The blaze was reportedly so intense that the firefighters were initially unable to tackle it. All 23 Indian nationals aboard the vessel were rescued following the incident, with no injuries reported, the authorities said. A recent drone attack by Ukraine has set an oil tanker ablaze off Russias Black Sea coast. The Liberian-flagged Aframax Rio was attacked off Sochi, triggering a massive fire. The tanker was carrying 23 Indians. Russian Transport Minister Andrey Nikitin convened an emergency response headquarters as officials said that sufficient personnel and equipment were deployed to manage the incident. The authorities temporarily closed beaches in the nearby federal territory of Sirius as a precautionary measure. Two commercial vessels hit by drones in Bulgarias Black Sea Economic Zone In a separate incident, Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev said that two commercial vessels were struck by drones in Bulgarias exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea on Tuesday, marking the first such attack in the area. The Bulgarian authorities said that the origin of the drones was under investigation. However, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy blamed Russia for the strikes. This is an unacceptable attack in Bulgarias exclusive economic zone. It is a blatant violation of international law and maritime law, the Bulgarian PM said, condemning the attack. The Togo-flagged Alfa Watan sank after suffering critical structural damage in the drone attack, with no immediate word on the crews fate, Radev said. The second vessel, the Palau-flagged Able, caught fire after the strike. A Bulgarian ferry rescued all 18 crew members, while two sailors suffered severe injuries and were then flown to a hospital in the port city of Varna.
