articleTitle: ‘Apni maa ki kasam khao’: When Nana Patekar refused to hear Anees Bazmee’s Welcome script
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Nana Patekar
description: Nana Patekar’s portrayal of Uday Shetty in Welcome remains one of his most loved performances. The film offered a refreshing change for fans who were used to seeing Nana play intense characters on screen.
body_raw: Veteran actor Nana Patekar, who died on Thursday morning at the age of 75 after suffering a heart attack, had a long and successful career in films and theatre. Over his decades-long career, he delivered several memorable performances, but his portrayal of Uday Shetty in Anees Bazmees Welcome 2007 remains one of his most beloved roles. Interestingly, the actor had initially turned down the role. During an appearance on The Kapil Sharma Show Season 2, Anees Bazmee recalled how he approached Nana Patekar for the role in Welcome. He shared, I called him and told him I want to meet you. He replied, Kaai ko? Why? I told him that I want to narrate a film to you. The director recalled that when he visited Nana Patekars house to narrate the script, the actor refused to hear it and said, Mujhe kahaani nahin sunni Aneez. Tum apni maa ki kasam khao aur batao ki mujhe ye karna chahiye I dont want to listen to the story, Anees. You swear on your mother and tell me whether I should do this film or not. However, Anees insisted that Nana hear the entire story, and the actor listened attentively to the three-hour narration. The director recalled that after hearing the script, Nana hugged him and said, Main kachhi mitti hoon. Tere set pe aayega, jis roop mein dhalna hai dhaal lena I am raw clay. When I come to your set, mould me into whichever shape you want. Also Read When Nana Patekar said he never found time to live Zindagi udhar ki hai On the show, Anees Bazmee also refuted industry rumours about Nana Patekar being difficult to deal with on sets. The entire film finished, and from his side, there wasnt even an issue the size of a dust particle. There is no work easier than working with him if you are honest with your script, said Anees. In a 2017 Filmfare interview, Anees also shared that Nana thanked him after the release of Welcome. After Welcome released, he told me, Anees, thanks for this film. Because my kids would always get scared of me. They never came near me. But Welcome changed my image in their minds. Now they come and sit on my lap. That was a very nice compliment for me. Nana Patekars portrayal of Uday Shetty in Welcome remains one of his most loved performances. The film offered a refreshing change for fans who were used to seeing Nana play intense characters on screen. His dialogue, Control, Uday. Control, became hugely popular and continues to be used by fans in everyday conversations. Another memorable line, Aloo lelo, kanda lelo, continues to inspire memes and jokes on social media.

articleTitle: Delhi Police bans gatherings at Rajghat after Congress announces protest against EC
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Delhi Police detain Congress supporters during a protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. (ANI)
description: Delhi Police bans gatherings at Mahatma Gandhi memorial after Congress announces protest against EC
body_raw: Congress and other INDIA bloc MPs began arriving for a second consecutive lunch meeting in Delhi on Thursday, with leaders expected to march to Rajghat afterwards to protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The meeting is being hosted by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge. Congress MP Kodikunnil Suresh said the Opposition would continue its protest and demanded Gyanesh Kumars resignation. He said the next strategy would be decided at the meeting, with Rahul Gandhi, Kharge, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other INDIA bloc leaders expected to lead the subsequent protest. The meeting comes a day after Delhi Police stopped an INDIA bloc march towards Jantar Mantar and detained several Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi. Police said three FIRs have been registered over the protest, including allegations of assault and manhandling of police personnel, obstruction of government work and misbehaviour. Sources in the INDIA bloc told The Indian Express that MPs from the alliance will meet for lunch at Moets restaurant in Connaught Place, a day after a lunch gathering turned into a street protest. Those expected to attend include TMCs Derek OBrien and Mahua Moitra, CPIMs John Brittas, IUMLs ET Mohammed Basheer, CPIs P Sandosh Kumar, and Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and Mallikarjun Kharge. The Samajwadi Party has sent two representatives for the lunch being hosted by Mallikarjun Kharge.Ghosi MP Rajeev Rai and Rampur MP Mohibbullah Nadvi will be in attendance. Rai confirmed to The Indian Express that the two MPs have been told by the party to attend the lunch. We are going there, said Rai. This comes a day after the SP skipped Wednesdays lunch and protest led by the Congress in Delhi demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumars resignation.
